reviews.text: This high quality and clean ingredients collgen coming with vitamin C is with no taste. I tried it with cold water, ice tea, and hot coffee, in all of them it mixed well, immediately or after few seconds. Practically highly recommended, you can take it anywhere anytime, just keep few in the office or in your bag so you can enjoy a refreshing beauty drink on the go.
reviews.zh: 呢款高質素、成分乾淨、含維他命 C 嘅膠原蛋白冇味道。我試過用冷水、冰茶同熱咖啡沖，每一樣都可以即時或者幾秒內溶勻。實際上我好推薦，你可以隨時隨地飲，辦公室或者袋入面放幾包，就可以喺外出時享受一杯清爽嘅美容飲品。

reviews.text: I’ve been trying the BOTO Small Molecular Collagen C 2g x 30 sticks, a convenient daily inner‑beauty supplement in powder stick form that combines low‑molecular fish collagen with Vitamin C, hyaluronic acid, and probiotics to support your skin’s hydration, elasticity and overall wellness from the inside out. The low‑molecular collagen is designed to be absorbed more easily by your body, and the lemon‑flavored sachets make it easy and tasty to take with water every day. Many users appreciate that it’s simple to use and offers a boost in hydration and skin feel over time,
reviews.zh: 我一直試緊 BOTO Small Molecular Collagen C 2g x 30 包裝，呢個係一款方便每日飲用嘅內在美容補充劑，粉末條裝，結合咗低分子魚膠原蛋白、維他命 C、透明質酸同益生菌，由內而外支持皮膚水分、彈性同整體健康。低分子膠原蛋白設計成易被身體吸收，檸檬味嘅小包裝令每日加水飲用都好方便、好好味。好多用家欣賞佢用法簡單，而且隨時間過去，有助提升水分同皮膚感覺。

reviews.text:
i just start it and I need to wait to see results but overall I’m satisfied with the taste ( no fishy aftertaste for those who are sensitive to fishy taste) and I liked the idea of sachets it’s so practical you can handle it with you wherever you are 

I ll come back to give you my review about its effectiveness 🫰🏼
reviews.zh:
我啱啱開始飲，要等吓先見到效果，但係整體嚟講，我對味道好滿意（對魚腥味敏感嘅人，飲完唔會有魚腥尾味），我又鍾意小包裝嘅概念，好實用，你去到邊都可以帶住。

我之後會返嚟分享我對效果嘅評價 🫰🏼

reviews.text: This type of collagen helps support skin health and makes your skin glow. You need to take it daily to see improvements. I usually take it before going to sleep, as that is the best time for the body to repair collagen, and this supplement helps boost the process.
reviews.zh: 呢類膠原蛋白有助支持皮膚健康，令皮膚有光澤。要每日服用先會見到改善。我通常瞓覺前飲，因為瞓覺係身體修復膠原蛋白最好嘅時間，呢款補充劑有助加強呢個過程。

reviews.text: I was scared that it would taste too artificial but in reality it doesn't have any unpleasant tastes or smell, forme it has slightly sour taste and not hard to drink it. I will wait for result for my skin and got back with additional review.
reviews.zh: 我原本驚佢嘅味道會太假，但係實際上冇咩難聞嘅味道或者氣味。對我嚟講佢有少少酸，唔難飲。我會等皮膚嘅效果，之後再回嚟補充評論。

reviews.text: The BOTO Small Molecular Collagen C serum is a standout for its lightweight texture and quick absorption. Infused with collagen and Vitamin C, it provides a noticeable boost in skin hydration and radiance. My skin feels plumper and more even after using it consistently. While it's effective, the results may take a bit of time to fully appear. Overall, it’s a great option for those looking to enhance their skincare routine with a focus on hydration and brightening.
reviews.zh: BOTO Small Molecular Collagen C 精華以輕盈質地同快速吸收而突出。加入咗膠原蛋白同維他命 C，明顯加強皮膚水分同光采。持續使用之後，我嘅皮膚感覺更加飽滿、膚色更加均勻。雖然有效，但效果可能要一段時間先會完全顯現。總括嚟講，對於想加強護膚程序、側重補水同提亮嘅人嚟講，係一個好好嘅選擇。

reviews.text: This is VERY light and refreshing! It tastes the same as adding a slice of lemon in water so it's not very sour at all and has a TINY hint of sweetness to it, so it's perfect if you hate strongly flavored beverages and this makes it so easy to drink! The effects are so apparent even after only using mine for four days! My skin feels so much plumper and since it has probiotics I feel that my digestion is much better too! Will definitely re-purchase <3
reviews.zh: 非常清爽、好輕盈！味道好似喺水入面加咗一片檸檬咁，所以唔會好酸，而且帶有一絲絲甜味，如果你唔鍾意太濃味嘅飲品，呢款就最完美，好易入口！我只係用咗四日，效果已經好明顯！皮膚感覺飽滿好多，而且因為含有益生菌，我覺得消化都好好多！一定會再買 <3

reviews.text:
60 sticks - it is supply for 2 months. 

I'm drinking for week - and the skin is getting better. Besides GI tract also feels better. It has slightly lemony taste but not strong more like you are drinking bitter lemon soda.

two thumbs up for packaging, convenient to use, easy to take with you for travel or if you are in hurry for office.
reviews.zh:
60 包，夠用兩個月。

我飲咗一個星期，皮膚開始有改善。另外腸胃都感覺好啲。味道有少少檸檬味，但係唔會好濃，更似飲緊苦檸檬汽水。

包裝好讚，用起嚟方便，旅行或者趕返辦公室嗰時都易帶。
